summary: R1: BuildWorkloadSnapshot now sums canonical in-window DailyRow.Tokens independently of model maps, exposes workload.unclassifiedTokens, trusts model categories only when they cover the day exactly, and treats inconsistent classification as unclassified instead of scaling bad data.
